resources.string: An application developed by Thibaut Perrin, based on the board game created by Maxime Vial in 2004.

Tetrano is a two player game.
 Each player successively puts a ring on the game board in order to create a four-ring series of a color.
 This series can be:
 - concentric : 4 rings of different sizes are placed in the same square,
 - or linear : 4 rings of the same size, or arranged in an ascending or a descending order of size, are placed on a line, a column or a diagonal.
 The game ends when one of the players succeeds in creating a four-ring series in the color he chose.
 To play a ring, drag and drop it to the square in which you aim to put this ring.
 Have fun!

Welcome in the Challenge mode,

in this mode, you start from an already begun game, and you can use only a limited number of rings to win. If you don’t win the game with this limited number, you lose. If you win the game using the good number of rings, you win and you can go to the next level.

Be careful, if you lose twice consecutively, an advertisement will appear!
